color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center; width: 460px;

span.p:
Generate — select and tailor, never invent
a curated bank.yaml organised by rubric domain
Tier 1 ≈ 60 · Tier 2 ≈ 30 · Tier 3 ≈ 12, plus AI-specific questions when is_ai_vendor
Style rule — no yes/no questions. Do you encrypt data? becomes list encryption
standards at rest and in transit and attach your key-management policy.
Specificity is what makes the later contradiction detection possible at all

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Send through the gateway — P1 token required for a new contact
idempotency key review_id : questionnaire_send : v1

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
A message arrives
days later, partial

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Screen the reply body first
an injection can arrive in an email just as easily as in a PDF —
demonstrating that you understood this is a differentiator

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center; width: 460px;

span.p:
Parse this message alone · Flash
merge into qa_responses keyed by question_id,
recording confidence and source_msg for the binder's parse provenance

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Quote it back to the analyst queue · needs_human
an unparseable answer is never silently dropped

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center; width: 460px;

span.p:
Schedule the next chase — three days out, its own idempotency key
reminder → deadline notice → escalation to the analyst

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NEEDS_HUMAN
three rounds without a reply is
an analyst's problem, not a loop

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
publish review.findings_ready
the Evidence agent takes over

svg.text: Drawbridge — The questionnaire loop: replies arrive in fragments, over days
